text:
nina: Prospect requires BYO-HSM for the POC and wants an explicit rotation playbook + auditor checklist. They also asked if we can run a rotation dry-run in staging with their keys. cc @sam @oliver

sam: Two modes we support: proxy (runtime calls to their KMS) or pre-wrapped CEKs (no runtime KMS). For proxy expect ~3-7ms added latency; pre-wrapped has no runtime latency.

oliver: Auditor FAQ: we never persist raw key material. We store key IDs, envelopes, and audit logs only. Will attach attestation excerpt.

rachael: Ops notes: proxy-mode needs outbound 443 to KMS endpoints and optional mTLS. For on-prem HSM our keyproxy uses 1500/tcp. We'll provide a one-page firewall snippet.

nina: Pricing: customer asks for trial discount if they supply HSM. Can we offer something?

sam: If they BYO and perform local wrapping we can offer a POC credit (up to 15%) and waive trial egress charges. Legal needs a CMK addendum signed.

oliver: For rotation: recommend staged roll with canary verification + rollback to previous key ID. Require customer's unwrap credential for acceptance tests.

nina: Action items: sam to draft pricing language, oliver to produce auditor checklist + rotation playbook, rachael to draft firewall snippet. Schedule handoff with sales and legal on Thurs.

sam: On it.

rachael: I'll upload the snippet by EOD.
